privacy.localStorageBody: Your personal health logs, period dates, symptoms, and notes are stored privately and locally on this device. No cloud telemetry or automatic cloud backups are performed for your tracking data.
privacy.offlineNotice: Your tracking logs are stored 100% locally on this device.

dashboard.title: Health Overview
dashboard.subtitle: Your private cycle & daily health summary
dashboard.noCycleData: Log your period dates to view predicted cycles, fertile windows, and health statistics.
dashboard.privacyFooter: 100% Offline & Private — Stored strictly on this device in local IndexedDB.

period.title: Period Records
period.subtitle: Track your menstrual period dates and flow intensity locally and privately.
period.deleteConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this period entry? This action is permanent and clears the entry from your local device storage.
period.emptyDescription: Log your period start and end dates to maintain your private health history.

validation.endDateBeforeStart: End date cannot be earlier than start date.
validation.futureDateDisallowed: Future period dates cannot be logged ahead of time.

calendar.title: Personal Health Calendar
calendar.subtitle: Visualizing your recorded period history on an offline, private calendar.
calendar.noRecord: No period recorded for this date
calendar.offlineGuarantee: 100% Offline Personal Health Calendar — Recorded facts only (no prediction AI)
calendar.readyDescription: Log your period dates to see them visualized across monthly calendars.

dailyHealth.title: Daily Health Log
dailyHealth.subtitle: Record how you feel each day, privately on this device.
dailyHealth.editExisting: You are editing today's existing log
dailyHealth.noLogTitle: No health information recorded for this day
dailyHealth.noLogDescription: Add a daily log to keep a private record of how you felt today.
dailyHealth.saveFailed: Could not save your daily log. Please try again.
dailyHealth.loadFailed: Could not load your health log. Please try again.
dailyHealth.deleteMessage: This will permanently remove today's health log from your local device storage.

validation.invalidSleep: Sleep must be between 0 and 24 hours.
validation.invalidHydration: Hydration must be between 0 and 10000 ml.
validation.futureDateDisallowed: Future health logs cannot be recorded ahead of time.

health.sectionDailySubtitle: Symptoms, mood, pain, sleep, and hydration

analytics.title: Your Recorded Health
analytics.subtitle: Deterministic, factual summaries of your private records — computed entirely on this device.
analytics.noCycleData: Log your period dates to see cycle statistics here.
analytics.noDailyData: Log daily health entries to see statistics here.
analytics.insufficientCycle: Record another cycle to compare cycle lengths.
analytics.insufficientPeriod: Record another period to compare durations.
analytics.insufficientPain: Record pain on a few more days to compute an average.
analytics.insufficientSleep: Record sleep on a few more days to compute an average.
analytics.insufficientHydration: Record water intake on a few more days to compute an average.
analytics.cycleTrendHint: Each entry is a recorded cycle length in days.
analytics.error: Could not load your health records. Please try again.

insights.basedOn: Based on what you have recorded
insights.empty: Log a few days to see personal insights here.
